subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): let runtime completions request reasoning

question: Should the public plugin completion API expose only generic model reasoning levels, or the broader session thinking vocabulary including `adaptive` and `ultra`?
rationale: This becomes a shipped plugin SDK contract; the current downstream transport has distinct model-level semantics and does not support `ultra`, so the permanent public vocabulary needs an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Use a completion-specific type
options.body: Expose only levels with defined generic completion semantics and keep session-only values such as `ultra` out of this API.

options.title: Normalize every ThinkLevel
options.body: Keep the full session vocabulary only after defining and testing provider-independent normalization for `adaptive`, `max`, `ultra`, and `off`.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Leave the linked issue open until the shared plugin and LLM-core reasoning contract is designed together.

recommendation.title: Use a completion-specific type
recommendation.body: Expose only levels with defined generic completion semantics and keep session-only values such as `ultra` out of this API.

likelyOwner.reason: The LLM-core extraction and provider-contract history make this the strongest available owner signal for the permanent public type boundary.
